facts.business: Asian Paints Limited is India's leading paint and décor brand and among the world's foremost decorative coatings companies, offering paints, waterproofing, lights, kitchen categories, and advanced colour systems like Chromacosm.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key audit matter: Revenue recognition (cut-off assertion) - testing controls around dispatches/deliveries, inventory reconciliations, circularization of receivable balances, cut-off testing, and analytical review procedures.

key_risks: Revenue recognition susceptible to misstatement due to cut-off issues
Rapidly evolving market and competitive dynamics
Macro-economic outlook and prevailing business conditions
